sources: recreation.gov public campsite search for 10005349 (catx.py, read 2026-10-22)

values.note: $25 a night per camping unit (each RV or tent; a site takes 1 RV and 1 tent or 2 tents); group RV site $80 (walk-up group season $170). Day use $5 per vehicle. The $8 reservation fee is non-refundable.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10005349/rates (2026-05-01 to 2026-09-30 Peak Season: 25 per standard/RV site, PeakGroupRVCampsite 80) + rec.gov notice ('Each RV or tent is considered a camping unit, and each camping unit costs $25') + https://www.blm.gov/visit/log-gulch-campground ('The $8 reservation fee is non-refundable'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/log-gulch-campground ('There are no hook-ups available') + rec.gov notices ('No hook-ups are available', 'There is no power available on-site for campers'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 70 sites with spacious gravel pads for RVs, camper trailers and tents (including Sardine Row, sites 1-12, by the boat launch); Little Log Gulch is tent-only. Each site takes 1 RV and 1 tent or 2 tents. The catalog gives no usable vehicle lengths.

sites.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/log-gulch-campground ('a 70-site campground that has spacious and gravel parking pads that accommodate RVs, camper trailers, and tents', 'Sardine Row (sites 1-12)') + rec.gov notice ('Log Gulch can only accommodate 1 RV and 1 tent or 2 tents at each site', 'Little Log Gulch is limited to tents only'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Potable water to fill containers (bring a white potable hose), seasonal. No black or grey water dump. Concrete boat launch with courtesy dock and first-come day-use and overnight dock slips; garbage dumpsters.

facilities.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/log-gulch-campground ('There is potable water provided throughout the campground', boat launch and docks) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10005349 (notices 'There is no black or grey water dump on site', 'Potable water is available throughout the campground to fill containers. Please bring a white potable hose'; amenities 'Vault Toilets', 'Water (Seasonal)'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'ALL sites are reservation only to include Sardine Row and Little Log.' Stay limit 7 consecutive days and 14 days in a 28-day period. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out 11 a.m. Managed by the BLM Butte Field Office.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10005349 (notices 'Stay limit is 7 consecutive days and 14 days within a 28-day time period. ALL sites are reservation only', check-in/out; rule maxConsecutiveStay 7) + https://www.blm.gov/visit/log-gulch-campground ('All sites are reservation only', 'This site is managed by Butte Field Office'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'Discounts are only available for those carrying a Senior or Access National Park Pass. You must have your pass with you.'

note: BLM campground on Holter Lake (Missouri River) ~45 mi north of Helena, 4.5 mi past Holter Lake Campground on Beartooth Road; shade trees, lakeside picnic tables and a large boat launch. --Claude
summary: BLM page + rec.gov: confirmed $25 (2026, per camping unit), no hookups, 70 sites, potable water, reservation-only on rec.gov; added $8 reservation fee, vault toilets, no dump, 7-night consecutive limit, Senior/Access discount (stated). Not stated: season (only the May-Sept rate season), max rig length, booking window. The BLM page's 'Temporary closure Sept. 14 to Oct. 11' for site improvements has passed, so no status recorded.
